Pfeile → ü 日本

Pfeile are arrows in German, and this page checks that non-ASCII text survives fetching, cleaning, indexing and search. The Japanese word 日本 means Japan, and the letter ü appears in many German words such as Übung.

Usage

Write Pfeile with the arrow → between two names to show a direction. Both 日本 and ü must come back from a search unchanged, with no replacement characters and no encoding errors on any platform.
